subject: Q4 bookings velocity — commit discipline & stage updates
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 bookings velocity — commit discipline & stage updates

Team — quick note ahead of tomorrow's forecasting sync. Finance flagged a material tilt between current bookings and our committed pipeline for Q4; we need a fast, practical cleanup so the forecast we present to execs is defensible. Please do the following by EOD tomorrow: 

1) Update every active opportunity in HubSpot with a clear commit state: Commit / Commit-At-Risk / No-Commit. If you believe a deal should move to No-Commit, add 1–2 line rationale in the Deal Notes.
2) For any Commit or Commit-At-Risk deals: paste expected close date, SOC2 readiness status, and any procurement blockers into the ‘Close Plan’ field.
3) Attach the latest legal/SOW doc when available (filename pref: <account>_SOW_vX.pdf).

I attached a one-page commit sheet to make it fast — use it to name-check deals you want me to escalate in tomorrow's forecast call. I will escalate only those with a clear owner and dates.

Attachments: 2028Q4_commit_sheet.xlsx

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Sr. Director, Global Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 bookings velocity — commit discipline & stage updates

Got it, Rachel — thank you. Quick status on the Nimbus Analytics deal (NB-2028-1197):

- Current stage: Negotiation 
- Proposed close: 2028-10-20 (sales commit)
- Anchor risk: procurement requires a Redline-friendly SOW + 3rd party security attestation (they asked for latest SOC2 scope).
- Suggested commit state: Commit-At-Risk (conditional on SOC2 evidence and final PoP).

I've updated HubSpot and uploaded the draft SOW to the deal folder. Attaching the SOW we shared this morning. I’ll ping legal to prioritize the redline window.

Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_draft_v3.pdf

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the heads-up, Vivek / Rachel. We reviewed the SOW and have two small redlines on payment milestones and support SLA. Our procurement team also asked for a SOC2 summary — happy to accept a scoped attestation or the latest SOC2 report excerpt.

We remain aligned on a 10/20 target close date, but to confirm we need: 
- Final SOW with agreed milestones (we can sign same day)
- SOC2 summary (or attestation) uploaded to our secure portal
- PO requested within five business days of signature

I’ll upload our comments to the SOW and confirm by EOD. If things look good, we can be Commit.

--
Lara Mills
Head of IT Procurement
Nimbus Analytics
lara@nimbusanalytics.com

Subject: Re: Q4 bookings velocity — commit discipline & stage updates 

Thanks for the quick responses. Summary / action items for the forecasting sync: 

- NB-2028-1197 (Nimbus) — current recommended state: Commit-At-Risk. Owner: Vivek. Close target: 2028-10-20. Next step: legal to complete redline turnaround; finance to accept PO within five days of signature.
- Please update HubSpot for any deal you believe is not realistically closing this quarter. If marked No-Commit, add 1–2 sentences explaining the blocker (procurement, budget, timeline, or technical).
- I will escalate up if we still have more than $1.2M in Commit-At-Risk without firm PO dates by the forecast lock.

I attached the aggregate commit sheet for today's review — I pulled it from HubSpot so we can call out moves quickly. If you want me to surface specific deals to the execs, reply to this thread with row numbers from the sheet.

Attachments: 2028Q4_commit_sheet.xlsx

Meeting: Forecasting sync Thu 10/5 9:00 AM PT — please be prepared with updated deal notes.

Rachel
